title: 17th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/17/1/2025).
Approval of the minutes of four previous sittings (minutes Nos. 10/1/2025 to 13/1/2025).
Judiciary Committee report on the President's nomination of Al-Ustaz Hussain Shaheed (Baazee, S. Hithadhoo) as a Justice of the Supreme Court under Article 148(a) of the Constitution.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nomination of a Permanent Representative of the Maldives to the UN Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (UN ESCAP).
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nomination of a non-resident ambassador to the Kingdom of Denmark.
Economic Committee report on the Bill amending the Maldives Tourism Act (Law No. 2/99).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to take up committee reports on a Supreme Court justice nominee, two diplomatic appointments (UN ESCAP and Denmark) and the Tourism Act amendment bill, then vote on them.
